region: Second outer candidate landmass; unrelated to confirmed Tangxi watershed
fixed_rain: V2.9 seasonal_south_band annual-normalized precipitation weights; mean per valid cell =1 (not measured rainfall).
modeling: Recomputed artificial coarse DEM priority-flood + steepest-gradient D8 routing; four spatial runoff-coefficient land-cover sensitivities. Non-runoff part is an unmodeled partition including infiltration/ET/interception, not measured groundwater storage. For lake experiment, 4 abstract intervals carrying 12%, 50%, 26%, 12% of model annual precipitation, baseline c=0.40, local wet-season runoff without travel delays. Two selected interior drainage cells intercept all upstream D8 inflows: 82% of current interval inflow may be retained if capacity; 28% of opening storage released each interval; overflow passes immediately. Water conservation includes ending storage.
definitions: Precipitation and runoff values are abstract grid-index water units; reservoirs are candidate nodes, not real glacial lakes, towns, or measured capacities. Artificial 0-level coast; no geographic scale, real evapotranspiration, true precipitation, snowpack, groundwater or real-time hydrographs.

coefficient_scenarios.name: 低渗透／疏植被
coefficient_scenarios.description: Synthetic coefficient 0.58–0.79. This is a sensitivity test, not urban land coverage.

caveats: Runoff coefficient map is a hypothetical land-cover proxy; the model does not separately solve porous soil, vegetation leaf area, evapotranspiration, groundwater and snowpack.
No mapped lake polygons or true lake depths are calculated; storage sites represent connected routing nodes with artificial abstract capacities.
Delay is a four-interval bookkeeping algorithm, not a flood-peak forecast nor a hydrograph with time travel.
Seasonal interval lengths are model fractions; do not map to Orbina real months/days.
Higher average rainfall-to-runoff factors do not assert actual climate, flood hazard, terrain area or ocean current.
Landmass, lake nodes, and M01/M03 mouth sectors remain candidates.
